spans.s:
N. of a wild tribe (who lives in the Vindhya hills, in the forests of Mālawa, Mewar, Khandesha and the Deccan); मलये भिल्लपुरन्ध्री चन्दनतरुकाष्ठमिन्धनं कुरुते [[Subhāṣ.]] 
-ल्ली 
__1 The lodhra tree. 
__2 A woman of the Bhil tribe; भिल्ली पल्लवशङ्कया बितनुते सान्द्रद्रुम … [[Udb.]] 
-Comp. 
-गवी the female of the Bos gavoeus. 
-तरुः the lodhra tree. 
-भूषणम् the guṅjā plant.
